name: sunlite-ota
description: Build and send the active UBC Solar firmware target to the Sunlite Raspberry Pi OTA gateway.

buildBeforeFlash.description: Build the active CMake target before uploading it.

configurationSnippets.label: Sunlite OTA: Flash active CMake target
configurationSnippets.description: Build, upload, and start OTA flashing through the Raspberry Pi gateway.

sunliteOta.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Sunlite Raspberry Pi.

sunliteOta.user.description: SSH user on the Raspberry Pi.

sunliteOta.sshPort.description: SSH port on the Raspberry Pi.

sunliteOta.incomingDirectory.description: Absolute untrusted-upload directory on the Raspberry Pi.

sunliteOta.gatewayExecutable.description: Absolute path to the sunlite-ota executable on the Raspberry Pi.

sunliteOta.objcopyPath.description: Local objcopy executable used to convert the active ELF to a raw OTA binary.

sunliteOta.buildBeforeFlash.description: Build the active CMake target before uploading it.

sunliteOta.automaticVersioning.description: Query the selected board and automatically compile the next monotonic firmware version before flashing.

sunliteOta.privateKeyPath.description: Local Ed25519 private PEM key used to sign development firmware. Never copy it to the Pi.

sunliteOta.statusTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the telemetry board to confirm the new firmware.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check ota-contract.js && node --test test/*.test.js
